sentences.chinese: 我的客厅里有一个白色的沙发。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de kètīng lǐ yǒu yí ge báisè de shāfā.
sentences.english_hint: There's a white sofa in my living room.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated likely use of 要 for possession; 白色的沙发 was successful.
Analysis corrects 我们要……微波炉 when describing an existing appliance.

sentences.english_hint: I don't want to speak English.
sentences.scenario: Keep your Chinese practice in Chinese.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我想不说英文 and repeated difficulty expressing this intention.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge cí wǒ bú huì shuō.
sentences.english_hint: I don't know how to say this word.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you are stuck speaking.
focus: 不会 for lack of skill
sentences.source_note: Analysis distinguishes 不会 from 不能 and 不可以 during word-searching.

sentences.chinese: 我没听清楚，请再说一遍。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīng qīngchu, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.
sentences.english_hint: I didn't hear clearly. Please say it again.
sentences.scenario: Ask someone to repeat missed information.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated 没听过 when information in a recording was missed.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào le, dànshì tīng bu dǒng.
sentences.english_hint: I heard it, but I don't understand.
sentences.scenario: Explain a listening difficulty in class.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this contrast; later 听不懂 was used correctly.

sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ yǒu sì kē shù.
sentences.english_hint: There are four trees in the garden.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 四本……树; learner subsequently used 四棵树 successfully.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de diànshì yīnzhì hěn hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: My TV has very good sound quality.
sentences.scenario: Explain what you like about your TV.
sentences.source_note: Analysis offers this precise correction for repeated 有很好音响.

sentences.chinese: 我的电视花了两千美元。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de diànshì huā le liǎng qiān měiyuán.
sentences.english_hint: My TV cost two thousand dollars.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone how much your TV cost.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated price fragments such as 二千美元贵.

sentences.chinese: 这张桌子比宜家的桌子贵很多。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi bǐ Yíjiā de zhuōzi guì hěn duō.
sentences.english_hint: This table is much more expensive than IKEA's.
focus: A 比 B + adjective + 很多
sentences.source_note: Completes the learner's unfinished comparison with an IKEA table.

sentences.pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu yí ge yùshì yǒu yùgāng.
sentences.english_hint: Only one bathroom has a bathtub.
sentences.scenario: Explain which bathroom has a tub.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects repeated attempts at expressing 只有一个.

sentences.chinese: 我想坐公交车或者地铁。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò gōngjiāochē huòzhě dìtiě.
sentences.english_hint: I'd like to take a bus or the subway.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 还是 in a statement about the learner's transport preferences.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí shì zhōngxīn hěn jìn.
sentences.english_hint: My home is close to the city center.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects fragmented distance descriptions without assuming travel method.

sentences.chinese: 如果我不会修，就给岳父打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ bú huì xiū, jiù gěi yuèfù dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.english_hint: If I can't fix it, I'll call my father-in-law.
sentences.scenario: Explain what you do when a repair is too difficult.
sentences.source_note: Shortens the analysis correction for the learner's repair plan; 打话 recurred.
